analysis_md:
解析：

$P=(x^2+y^2)^m y，\quad Q=-(x^2+y^2)^m x，$

$$\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=(x^2+y^2)^m+2my^2(x^2+y^2)^{m-1}，$$

$$\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=-(x^2+y^2)^m-2mx^2(x^2+y^2)^{m-1}。$$

由 $\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}$，得 $m=-1$
